Define proper time for fixed event pair at same point in rest inertial frame, minimum among inertial-frame coordinate intervals for that pair. Preserve 5 s proper time and 6 s, 10 s possible nonzero-speed coordinate intervals, not one universal pair of speeds. Time dilation is not an absolute preferred clock or all clocks individually ticking more between spatially separated events. Reciprocal claim refers to a different pair at rest in K. Preserve K/K_1 equivalence and interval's frame dependence.
Join decay-experiment introduction to p0258#1; retain observational evidence of time dilation without claiming each particle has fixed lifetime.

Actual mean lab distance v*gamma*tau_0. Preserve source's predictive-value argument while clearly attributing historical ignorance of pion structure/decay, not stating modern ignorance.

Simultaneity and intervals depend on frame, challenging low-speed intuition. v much less than c makes effects tiny, not nonexistent. Preserve scientific reasoning and precise experiment as tools for high-speed phenomena; source marker ② maps to p0258#4.

independentScienceRequirements.requirement: Use one fixed, timelike event pair to compare tau_0 and tau. Identify its rest clock and distinct coordinates in K.

K interval is coordinate time from synchronized clocks at event locations, or equivalently a properly corrected measurement. It is not raw light-arrival delay, audible reception delay or a single remote clock directly witnessing both events.
State inertial frames, subluminal v, invariant vacuum c; gamma>=1 and >1 for v nonzero.
Rest light clock: two parallel mirrors, transverse rod l, return to lower mirror, path 2l and tau_0=2l/c.
K light path: two equal legs duration tau/2, horizontal v*tau/2 and vertical l; total distance and time yield exact retained equation.
Positive-root algebra recovers exact time dilation; any teaching additions agree with retained formula and dimensions.

Minimum means rest inertial proper time versus other inertial coordinate times for same pair, not maximization/minimization of arbitrary accelerated worldlines. Reciprocal frame examples use another rest event pair.
Particle lifetime and path example are ensemble means/characteristic scales. Individual decays are variable; both languages must avoid deterministic 2.6e-8 s or 78 m claims.
Near-c approximation is explicit: mean lab path v*gamma*tau_0, approximate gamma*c*tau_0. Gamma=10 entails v<c, so 78 m is approximate, not exact.
Charged pion is now known as a composite meson, not elementary. Keep historical footnote content visible and attribute historical terminology/ignorance without corrupting snapshot.
Low-speed limits and relativity of simultaneity do not imply a sensory illusion or vanishing exact effect. Keep empirical/predictive significance.
